## How it was checked

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Scores for existing languages are byte-identical, **or** this is a scoring change and the
      development and held-out numbers are in the description (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No recordings or third-party data added to the repository
- [ ] No planning notes, logs or result dumps; any script used for the numbers runs on a fresh clone
